title_en: Jilin Zhongchengjian Zhongda Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. — Petition for Retrial
ruling_gist_en: The circumstances where the person subject to execution and other persons, under the guise of complex capital contributions to establish a new company, share acquisitions, and mergers, transfer the main assets including the project and related land over which a creditor has a priority right to be repaid from the project price to the name of the newly established company, while the other persons control the majority equity of the newly established company and the newly established company does not assume the debt of the project price, may be determined as a transfer of assets between the person subject to execution, the other persons, and the newly established company, infringing upon the lawful rights and interests of the priority creditor of the project price. The other persons and the newly established company shall, as successors to the rights and obligations of the person subject to execution, bear liability to such priority creditor. The enforcement court has the authority to rule to add the other persons and the newly established company as persons subject to execution.

full_text_en:
Jilin Zhongchengjian Zhongda Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. — appeal case

Ruling Summary

Where a person subject to enforcement, through complex transactions including capital contribution to form a new company, acquisition of shares, and merger, transfers major assets, including projects and related land on which creditors enjoy a priority right to satisfaction, to the newly formed company, and the other party controls the majority equity of the new company, and the new company does not assume the debt of the project price, such circumstances may be determined as a transfer of assets between the person subject to enforcement, the other party, and the newly formed company, infringing upon the lawful rights and interests of the priority creditor for the project price. The other party and the newly formed company shall be liable to such priority creditor as successors to the rights and obligations of the person subject to enforcement. The enforcement court has the authority to rule to add the other party and the newly formed company as persons subject to enforcement.

Supreme People's Court
Notice of Dismissal of Appeal

(2011) Zhi Jian Zi No. 15

To: Jilin Zhongchengjian Zhongda Real Estate Development Co., Ltd.:

Regarding your company's appeal against the Enforcement Ruling (2009) Tie Zhong Zhi Er Fu Zi No. 6 of the Shenyang Railway Transport Intermediate Court and the Enforcement Rulings (2009) Ji Tie Zhi Zi No. 3-9, 3-17, and 3-18 of the Jilin Railway Transport Court, this Court has reviewed the case and, following deliberation by the Adjudication Committee, hereby replies as follows:

1. During the enforcement of the dispute over the construction project contract between Jilin Dong'ao Engineering Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Dong'ao Company") and Jilin Zhongda Transportation Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Zhongda Company"), Zhongda Company, the person subject to enforcement, through a "Debt Restructuring Agreement," transferred the land use rights of Zone A and Zone B of "Zhongda Century City" to your company and Jilin Zhongkong Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Zhongkong Company"), respectively, under the guise of capital contribution. Subsequently, your company acquired all of Zhongda Company's equity in Zhongkong Company; Zhongkong Company acquired Zhongda Company's Zone B land and unsold housing assets for a price of RMB 100 million; and your company and Zhongkong Company assumed RMB 100 million of Zhongda Company's debts. As a result of the foregoing asset and equity transfers, Zhongda Company transferred the Zone B land to Zhongkong Company but held no equity in Zhongkong Company; it transferred the Zone A land to your company, holding only a minority equity interest; and your company and Zhongkong Company assumed only part of Zhongda Company's debts. This situation shall be determined as a transfer of assets among Zhongda Company, your company, and Zhongkong Company, and such asset transfer infringed upon the creditor's rights. Your company and Zhongkong Company shall be liable to the creditor Dong'ao Company as successors to the rights and obligations.

2. Dong'ao Company's priority right to satisfaction for the project price with respect to the Zone B project of Zhongda Century City is obtained by operation of law, and its priority is superior to general claims and other security interests. Given the existence of a statutory priority right, Zhongda Company's disposal of the Zone B land and its above-ground structures through the "Debt Restructuring Agreement" with your company and Zhongkong Company infringed upon the interests of the priority holder. Dong'ao Company has the right to pursue recovery against the Zone B land and its above-ground structures and claim priority satisfaction. In view of the fact that the Zone B land and its above-ground structures have been disposed of by Zhongkong Company, Dong'ao Company has the right to directly recover from Zhongkong Company. Since your company holds 100% of the equity in Zhongkong Company, your company and Zhongkong Company shall jointly bear liability to Dong'ao Company, the creditor of Zhongda Company.

3. Regarding your company's assertion that Zhongda Company has fully performed the obligations under the Civil Mediation Letter (2005) Shen Tie Min Fang Chu Zi No. 10 and has filed a separate lawsuit for the excess performance, the Creditor's Certificate issued by Shenyang Railway Transport Intermediate Court on February 10, 2007, under (2007) Zhai Zi No. 3, confirmed that the outstanding balance of the unenforced and unsatisfied creditor's rights in this case was RMB 16.32 million. During the subsequent resumption of enforcement, Zhongda Company failed to provide the court with sufficient evidence to prove full performance. Therefore, this Court does not support your company's assertion.

In conclusion, the Jilin Railway Transport Court's addition of your company as a person subject to enforcement and its direct seizure and disposition of your company's assets were not improper. The grounds for your company's appeal are untenable and are hereby dismissed.

August 17, 2011
